step: STEP 3 - labels at scale from the ink
sampling_rule: pool = images with a jpg + expected count >= 1 + no coordinate label in Label@CARS_202609_raw, excluding the 500 benchmark images; RandomState(11) shuffle, then sorted, take 5000

inherits_teacher_ceiling.statement: This corpus is generated by pm_v10, whose measured recall is 83.7% and precision 87.1% at D=5 on the 1076-box GT. Boxes pm_v10 does not see never enter the labels, so the corpus CANNOT recover the 175 FN and must never be used as an acceptance metric.

corpus_inventory.note: The benchmark uses only the 500 images from canny_quad.get_ids(); the label directory already covers ~56k images.  The DL retrain in STEP 1 was therefore starved by the 300-image compute cap, NOT by label availability.
